Weasel Rides on Back of Flying Woodpecker near London
A photo of a weasel riding on the back of a flying woodpecker near London has gone viral on Twitter, with over 7,000 retweets. The photo was taken by photographer Martin Le-May who was walking with his wife in a park when they heard a distressed squawking noise and spotted the woodpecker with the weasel on its back. The weasel eventually lost its grip and the bird flew away. The photo has been picked up by British media, and the photographer has been interviewed by ITV.
